## Timeline

Normal traffic til 02:14. Then:

- **02:14:07.113** — root cause. `[api] redis connection lost: connect ECONNREFUSED 10.0.0.12:6379`. Cache layer degrade, fall back to direct store reads.
- 02:14:08 onward — cache miss storm hit store direct, no cache buffer. Store overload, timeout errors 5000ms every service (api/worker-1/worker-2/scheduler) cycle repeat.
- Request queue depth climb steady 52 → 568, cap 500 blow past around 02:29 (depth 502).
- Redis reconnect attempt fail 12 times, spaced ~2min apart (02:15:26 through 02:31:26), never recover. Redis at 10.0.0.12:6379 stay dead whole incident.
- **02:31:44.902** — `[worker-2] JavaScript heap out of memory (request backlog)`. Queue backlog exhaust memory.
- 02:31:45.001 — supervisor restart worker-2 (exit code 134 = SIGABRT, OOM kill).
- **02:31:52.318** — `[supervisor] api unresponsive, killing process group — service down`. Full outage.

## Root cause
Redis at 10.0.0.12:6379 die 02:14. App fall back to direct DB read on cache miss, no circuit breaker / backoff limit, no queue cap enforce. Backlog grow unbounded 17+ min til worker OOM crash, then supervisor kill whole process group.

## Fix directions
- Add circuit breaker: fail fast on store overload instead of queue infinite.
- Enforce queue depth cap (dropped/reject past 500, not just log warn).
- Redis reconnect backoff never succeed — check why redis itself down/unreachable at 10.0.0.12, separate infra issue.
- Memory limit / backpressure on worker request queue to avoid OOM.
